request: Analyze GSE280845 for PMID 39747484 (Cellular Feimin enhances exercise performance by suppressing muscle thermogenesis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (DNBSEQ/BGISEQ-500, 50-bp SE), gastrocnemius, male mice
final.sample_inclusion: all 12 deposited samples (3 per genotype x exercise cell)
final.primary_estimand: acute-exercise (90-min run) effect on gastrocnemius gene expression in WT (fl/fl) mice; the paper's mechanistic question is how cFeimin MKO changes that response (Sln de-repression during exercise)
planned_contrasts: Exe vs Sed within WT (exercise effect; GEO overall_design)
Exe vs Sed within MKO (exercise effect in knockout)
MKO vs WT within Exe and within Sed (genotype effect; abstract: Sln up in MKO during exercise)

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO GSE280845 data_processing (authors' text): cutoff of log2 fold change (logFC) of +- 1 and a p-value < 0.05

final.paper_method: DESeq2 (v1.40.2) Wald test with contrast tests on StringTie gene counts (GEO data_processing)
final.paper_results: No full text: DEG counts not available. Abstract: cFeimin suppresses Sln expression during exercise via FOXC2; so Sln expected higher in MKO than WT after exercise.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: No full text was available. Study map built from the PubMed abstract (efetch PMID 39747484) and the GEO series (summary, overall_design, per-sample characteristics, data_processing). GEO overall_design: gastrocnemius of Sed and 90-min Exe fl/fl (WT) and cFeimin MKO male mice. data_processing states DESeq2 Wald contrasts and |log2FC| 1 with raw p<0.05.

checks: GEO series title equals the paper title
contact Yiguo Wang, Tsinghua = corresponding author
12 matrix columns = 12 GSM titles (one typo fixed)

ownership.reasoning: GSE280845 title/summary are the paper's; single supplementary count matrix with columns named by sample title.

alignment.reasoning: Exact match of matrix column names to GEO title. The deposited column Exe_KO_reap4 is a typo of title Exe_KO_rep4 (GSM8606529, the only unmatched title and the only unmatched column; both KO + 90-min running); renamed in prep/fix_column_typo.py without touching values. Title-derived ex/geno agree with the characteristics treatment/genotype columns (6/6 each).

matrix.reasoning: 100% integers, max 838179, median 0; data_processing: tab-delimited text file including raw counts for each sample, StringTie gene read counting, then DESeq2: the same input the paper used.

final.analysis_type: factorial 2x2 (exercise x genotype), one model on all 12 samples

candidates.value: pool genotypes for Exe vs Sed
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype is a manipulated factor the paper expects to change the exercise response; pooling would mix estimands
WT Sed vs WT Exe is a clean acute-exercise contrast with n=3 per arm

design.reasoning: Request is the exercise effect; GEO overall_design defines Sed vs 90-min Exe in fl/fl WT and MKO. Primary = exercise within WT; the other cells' comparisons and the interaction are exploratory, fitted in one model. All male (GEO design), so no sex split.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one sample each; no batch, lane or date recorded in GEO; all male.

method.reasoning: Paper used DESeq2 Wald contrast tests on raw counts; same route.

threshold.reasoning: Authors' GEO data_processing: |log2FC| >= 1 (stated as +- 1) and raw p < 0.05. Kept as raw p exactly; BH padj < 0.05 reported as a labelled audit rule.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract and GEO text only; no DEG counts available from the paper.
n=3 per cell; raw-p threshold is permissive.

study.reasoning: Abstract names Sln (suppressed by cFeimin during exercise, i.e. expected up in MKO vs WT after exercise) and FOXC2 (binding partner).

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 model on all 12 samples; planned exercise-in-WT contrast plus every analyzable comparison (exploratory).

enrichment.reasoning: pathway view of the primary exercise response
